compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined There is joy before God’s angels over repentance beside Angels obey the voice of the heavenly king; Angels and the heavenly army praise their creator; The prayer places an angelic army before the throne; The tempter quotes angelic protection and angels serve Jesus.
